use_cases: Implement when you need to rewrite Markdown files to match a specific authorial voice based on a JSON fingerprint.
Configure when you want to preserve specific non-voice blocks such as citations, footnotes, and blockquotes during style transfer.
Use when you need to measure stylometric deltas between original drafted text and an LLM-generated version.
Implement when deterministic post-processing like emoji substitution and base64 image restoration is required on rewritten text.
Use when handling oversized text prompts by chunking Markdown sections while maintaining meaning.
